name: Northshire Valley
summary: Northshire Valley shelters Stormwind's newest defenders in northern Elwynn Forest. Natural barriers guard the peaceful valley, where ancient Northshire Abbey, fertile vineyards, and the rich Echo Ridge Mine sustain a pocket of the kingdom. Bandits, kobolds, and displaced predators now trouble its quiet pastures.

sections.title: A Secluded Sanctuary
sections.body: Northshire Valley lies behind mountain ridges, with one road south through a fortified gatehouse toward Goldshire and the rest of Elwynn Forest. A clear river crosses the pastures and flows into Crystal Lake. At the valley's heart, ancient Northshire Abbey teaches the Holy Light and trains recruits under the Knights of the Silver Hand and seasoned veterans. Beyond its walls, the fertile Northshire Vineyards and Echo Ridge Mine make this a self-sustaining pocket of Stormwind territory, far from the wars beyond its ridges.

sections.title: Encroaching Troubles
sections.body: Stormwind's overextended defenses have strained even this sheltered valley. Marshal McBride and his detachment of the Stormwind Guard struggle to maintain order across it. Wolves driven north from blighted Duskwood prowl the woods, while kobolds have overrun Echo Ridge Mine's tunnels. Masked thugs aligned with the Defias Brotherhood harass the vineyards and threaten the abbey grounds, so local commanders recruit every able-bodied civilian who arrives at the gates.

faq.q: Why is Northshire Valley so heavily guarded?
faq.answer: Northshire Valley guards Northshire Abbey, a spiritual center and training ground for Stormwind's forces, as well as the vineyards and Echo Ridge Mine. With Stormwind's forces stretched thin, Marshal McBride holds the southern pass behind a guarded gate to keep threats from passing between the valley and greater Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Where did all the wolves in the valley come from?
faq.answer: Deputy Willem says wolves have recently crossed the river after fleeing Duskwood's darkened forests to the south. The spreading darkness there has driven wild beasts into the valley's tranquil pastures.

faq.q: Why are kobolds attacking Echo Ridge Mine?
faq.answer: Kobolds are opportunistic burrowers drawn to underground mineral veins. As kingdom patrols thinned, a clan took advantage of the lack of protection to claim Echo Ridge Mine for its gold and candles, forcing the human miners out of the tunnels.

faq.q: Who are the bandits harassing the vineyards?
faq.answer: The thieves near Milly Osworth's vineyard are agents of the Defias Brotherhood. They prey on the valley's outskirts to disrupt supplies, harass local farmers, and test the abbey's defenses.

faq.q: What happened to Northshire during the Second War?
faq.answer: During the Second War, Northshire Abbey fell into enemy hands and briefly served as a headquarters for Cho'gall's Twilight's Hammer clan. The Alliance later reclaimed and restored the valley.

faq.q: How do you leave Northshire Valley?
faq.answer: The only passable exit on foot is the southern road through the guarded gatehouse. It leads into central Elwynn Forest and points travelers toward Goldshire.

angles.text: As a human of Stormwind, your journey begins in Northshire Valley, where you enter the abbey grounds to answer the kingdom's call for help.
As an Alliance member, you find a vital place for recruitment and recovery in Northshire. The valley trains new defenders to stabilize the kingdom's heart.
